newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK future leader Tung to tout trade in China.
newsitem.headline: HK future leader Tung to tout trade in China.

text.p: Hong Kong's post-colonial leader Tung Chee-hwa will visit China next Tuesday on a trade-promotion tour, three months before he takes over as chief executive.

The Hong Kong Trade Development Council (TDC), a semi-official body that promotes trade and which organised the trip, said in a statement that Tung would give speeches at seminars in Shanghai and Beijing.
It said Tung will also attend a Beijing fair called "Greeting the Return of the Territory to China", at which senior Chinese leaders will be present.

The TDC organised the fair along with the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs office, the Chinese central government body in charge of Hong Kong policy, and the Xinhua News Agency, whose Hong Kong office serves as Beijing's de facto embassy.
Tung will succeed Governor Chris Patten at midnight on June 30 when Hong Kong reverts to Beijing's control after more than 150 years of British colonial rule.
